'''Karvas Toll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Toll grew up in the slums of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and after watching an Imperial propaganda program on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], he joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He spent a short time training offworld and then returned to Taris, to assist [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] cells on the world. Following the abduction of the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Saludor Narubo]] by the a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]], Toll trailed the agents and attempted to rescue Narubo.
